text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This keeps the ring visible against dark backgrounds while ensuring it doesn’t blend into light ones, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on high-DPI screens, but the clarity for keyboard users outweighs the minimal visual bulk.

name: Reader
text: A 4px outer ring with 2px white inner ring fails on patterned backgrounds where the white ring disappears into the pattern, making focus invisible. A safer alternative is a 3px solid ring in #005fcc with a 1px white inner ring—thinner but more reliable across all backgrounds. Settle it by testing on 3 patterned backgrounds at 3:1 contrast ratio; if any fail, switch to a 3px solid ring with no inner ring.
